posts.headline: We (Josh Xie, Purav Patel, Janani Prasad, and I) built Interpreter, placing 1st at the RETURN OF THE AGENTS hackathon hosted by Afore Capital and A...
posts.body: We (Josh Xie, Purav Patel, Janani Prasad, and I) built Interpreter, placing 1st at the RETURN OF THE AGENTS hackathon hosted by Afore Capital and AI Valley! Interpreter is a browser extension that allows anyone to translate audio live on any of their tabs, including YouTube videos, podcasts, and online meeting tools like Google Meet, Zoom Web, etc. We basically broke the language barrier for the web. With just one click, Interpreter locks onto the active tab and starts translating speech live. It then blocks the tab audio, filtering out the original audio and outputting only the translated...

posts.headline: Had a great time building again @ SHACK15 this weekend with my friends Subham K., Alazer Manakelew & Jiabao Hu!
posts.body: Had a great time building again @ SHACK15 this weekend with my friends Subham K., Alazer Manakelew & Jiabao Hu! This time, we built ProductKit (productkit.liftgate.io) - placing finalist at the Hack FLUX: Beyond One Hackathon! ProductKit allows anyone to turn anything in any image into a product listing, making it easy for anyone to showcase products online by automatically creating descriptions and consistent HD images, videos, and interactive 3D models, then syncing and displaying them straight to a storefront like Shopify, and handles storage and deployment across a full modern stack. posts.headline: Another day, another hackathon @ SHACK15.
